toast.outOfFuel: Out of fuel. The rescue drone is on its way.
fuel.greeting: Beep boop! Tank at {fuel} of {tank} l.
fuel.free: Pip tops you up for free. Beep!
fuel.broke: Not enough cash for fuel. Sell something first.
buyer.greeting: Let's see what you dug up.
buyer.empty: Your hold is empty. Go dig!
workshop.greeting: Hull at {hull} of {max}. What'll it be?
supply.greeting: Five slots, no more. Pick what saves your skin.
item.charge.effect: Clears 3 × 3 around the pod; minerals in it are lost
item.beacon.effect: Straight back to the surface, cargo and all
item.anchor.effect: Set it deep down; from the surface it takes you back once
toast.refused.hullFull: The hull is in one piece
toast.refused.empty: No equipment. Try the Supply Depot
pause.title: Paused
pause.line: Take a breather. The rock will wait.
pause.keys: Keys: {left} {right} or ← → drive and drill, {up}, ↑ or space flies, {down} or ↓ drills down, {enter} enters, 1–5 and {use} use equipment, {skip} skips the radio, Esc pauses.
pause.pad: Gamepad: stick or D-pad drives and drills, A flies, X uses, Y enters, B skips the radio, L R pick a slot, Start pauses.
radio.gus.intro: Welcome to Tumbra! The station is fading. Dig up something valuable and I'll fix up your rig.
radio.mira.intro: The old ones say the Heart of Tumbra beats deep in the core. Find anything old? Show me!
radio.pip.intro: Tank full. Flying up burns more than going down. Pip says: watch the gauge!
radio.gus.depth100: A hundred metres! Not bad. Keep going, the good stuff is deeper.
radio.pip.depth400: 400 metres! Pip is proud. Pip also reminds you: fuel.
radio.mira.depth900: Nine hundred metres! Nobody from the station has ever been this deep.
radio.gus.depth1400: 1,400 metres. Feel that heat? Down there, cooling isn't a luxury.
radio.mira.depth1900: 1,900 metres. The core is within reach. The whole station is rooting for you!
radio.gus.zone2: Clay caves. Mind the gas pockets: if one hisses, let go of the drill!
radio.gus.quake3: Whoa, an earthquake! It cracked open a new cave below you. A shortcut!
radio.gus.quake4: Another quake! Something down there is waking up. And lava burns, so stay clear.
radio.voice.zone4: …shhh… cold… …so long… in the dark… …can anyone hear…?
radio.mira.quake5: The whole station shook! Gus says the core is calling. I say: watch your step.
radio.gus.firstFall: Ouch! Brake with the engine before you land, or the hull pays for it.
radio.gus.firstGas: Gas! When a pocket hisses, let go of the drill in time and go around it.
radio.gus.firstLava: Lava! It doesn't flow, but it burns. Get out and give it a wide berth.
radio.gus.firstHeat: You're overheating! Better cooling lets you go deeper. For now, head up.
radio.pip.firstRescue: Pip sent the drone. The drone is expensive. Pip recommends fuel.
radio.gus.firstWreck: The rig's scrap. Never mind, I built you a new one. Your upgrades are safe.
radio.mira.cargoFull: Your hold is full! Whatever else you dig up will shatter. Come and sell!
radio.pip.fuelLow: Fuel below 20 %. Pip suggests: up, to Pip. Now.
radio.gus.firstUpgrade: There, the new part fits. Looks good, hm. Just don't break it.
radio.mira.mineral.1: Rustite! Cheap but honest. Every fortune starts with a rusty pebble.
radio.mira.mineral.2: Cobaltine! Blue as a summer sky. The painters in town will love it.
radio.mira.mineral.3: Glimmerite! It sparkles even in the dark. Careful, it makes people greedy.
radio.mira.mineral.4: Aurelite, the gold of Tumbra! Now we're talking. Pip, put the kettle on!
radio.mira.mineral.5: Skyquartz… cold to the touch, and it hums like the radio. Strange stone.
radio.mira.mineral.6: Emberstone! Still warm. Something down there keeps the rock warm.
radio.mira.mineral.7: Voidglass. Look inside and you see stars. No idea how. I'll buy it anyway!
radio.mira.mineral.8: A starheart! Like something out of a picture book. You're making history!
radio.mira.mineral.9: A core pearl… it pulses, as if it breathes. You're close to something big.
radio.mira.relic.1: A warm coin? Nobody on Tumbra ever minted those. Someone lived here long before us.
radio.mira.relic.2: It hums! Gus says it's the wind. Gus also talks to his wrenches.
radio.mira.relic.3: Their builders measured all the way down to the core. Why dig that deep?
radio.mira.relic.4: A glowing seed! It's going in a pot by my window. Not a word to Gus.
radio.mira.relic.5: Every vein leads to the core. The legend of the Heart… maybe it's not just a legend.
radio.mira.relic.6: They guarded the Heart day and night. And when they were gone… who did?
radio.mira.relic.7: They sang to it. So the Voice on the radio… is it looking for that song?
radio.mira.relic.8: A key to the Heart! It turns with six memories. Your relics, I bet.
radio.mira.relic.9: They left the Heart for whoever came next. That's… us, isn't it?
radio.mira.relic.10: A spark of the first fire. Bring it home safe. And yourself too, please.
radio.voice.heartNeedsRelics: …someone… is here… …too cold… …bring their memories… six…
radio.voice.heartReady: …I feel them… their memories… …light me… please…
radio.voice.ignite: WARMTH! …thank you… …but the core… is caving in… FLY!
radio.gus.escape: The core is collapsing and lava's rising! Full throttle, straight up!
radio.pip.retry: Pip brought you back to the Heart. The lava is slower this time. Again!
album.title: Album of relics
album.line: {count} of {total} relics found. Pick one for Mira's word on it.
album.hint: Dig around {depth} m. Relics hide in the rock like any other block.
album.relic.1: A coin that is still warm. A flame on one side, on the other tiny figures holding hands around it.
album.relic.2: Hold it to your ear and it hums a slow, steady beat, like a heart very far away.
album.relic.3: A measuring rod marked in strange units. Its last notch bears the sign of a heart.
album.relic.4: A seed that glows in the dark. The Builders grew light the way we grow potatoes.
album.relic.5: A map of warm rivers under the whole planet. Every one of them flows to the core.
album.relic.6: The mask of the Heart's keepers. The Wardens took turns by the Heart, so it never went out.
album.relic.7: Many voices carved into one stone: the song the Builders sang so the Heart was never alone.
album.relic.8: A key shaped like a flame. It opens no door, it wakes the fire. Six memories turn it.
album.relic.9: "We are leaving. The Heart will keep you warm a long, long time. Whoever finds this: light it again."
album.relic.10: A crumb of the Heart's very first fire, still burning after all these ages. It warms your hands.
ending.title: The Heart beats again
ending.text: Warm rivers run under the planet again. Flowers burst out of the rusty soil, the station lights every lamp it has, and Pip has not stopped beeping since.
ending.epilogue: With all ten memories home, the Choir Stone sings by itself at night. High above, new lights answer: the Builders are coming back to see who kept their Heart alive.
ending.hint: Somewhere down there more relics wait. Find all ten for an extra epilogue.
